title: Serve Simple CMS at http://cms.local from project-root DocumentRoot
summary: XAMPP httpd-vhosts.conf DocumentRoot is C:/xampp/htdocs/cms (project root, not public/). Windows hosts 127.0.0.1 cms.local. Do not ship a vhost file in the repo. CORS allow-list includes http://cms.local. Docs: DEVELOPMENTGUIDE, DEPLOYMENT, CONFIGURATION, September CHANGES.
